Our Story

Cinematic Storytelling
Rooted in Moroccan Soul

FM PROD is a Moroccan photography and videography studio based in the heart of Tinghir. We are passionate visual storytellers dedicated to preserving the authenticity, emotions, and beauty of your most precious moments.

Specializing in traditional Moroccan weddings, engagements, henna ceremonies, and cultural celebrations, we combine cinematic technique with deep cultural understanding to create visuals that transcend the ordinary.

Every frame we capture is a brushstroke in the painting of your story. Because today's emotions become tomorrow's greatest treasures.

48+ Productions
100% Satisfaction
